operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-1. Establishment and Structure

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-1

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-101. There is hereby established the President's Commission for a National Agenda for the Eighties.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-101

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-102. The Commission shall be composed initially of fifty members appointed by the President from among private citizens of the United States. Upon the request of the Commission, the President shall select and appoint no more than fifty additional members.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-102

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-103. The President shall designate the Chairperson of the Commission. The Chairperson, following consultations with Commission members, shall designate no more than fifteen members of the Commission to constitute an Executive Committee.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-103

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-104. The members of the Commission shall not receive compensation for their service on the Commission, but may receive travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-104

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-2. Functions and Reports

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-2

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-201. Under the direction of the Executive Committee, the Commission shall identify and examine the most critical public policy challenges of the 1980's. It shall examine issues related to the capacity for effective Federal governance, the role of private institutions in meeting public needs, and underlying social and economic trends, as these issues bear on our public policy challenges in the 1980's. Areas to be reviewed by the Commission shall include:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-201 (lead-in)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) underlying trends or developments within our society, such as the changing structure of our economy, the persistence of inflationary forces, demands on our natural environment, and demographic shifts within our population that will shape public choices in the 1980's;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-201(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) opportunities to enhance social justice and economic well-being for all our people in the 1980's;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-201(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) the role of private institutions, including the non-profit and voluntary sectors, in meeting basic human needs and aspirations in the future;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-201(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (d) defining the role of the public sector, and financing its responsibilities in the 1980's;

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-201(d)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
(e) impediments to building policy consensus, both within government—the Executive branch, Congress, State and local government—and within the Nation as a whole.

Within this framework, the Commission shall identify the specific issues appropriate for examination.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-201(e)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-202. The Chairperson of the Commission shall organize the Commission to study and make recommendations on major subject matter areas. This shall include the authority to appoint study panels and their chairpersons.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-202

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-203. The Executive Committee shall coordinate the work and act on behalf of the Commission as necessary.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-203

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-204. The Commission shall make every feasible effort to ensure citizen participation in the development of its Agenda and recommendations. The Commission, in preparing its recommendations, shall also consult with the Congress and with State and local officials.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-204

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-205. The Commission shall prepare a final report .setting forth its recommendations for addressing its Agenda for the Eighties and shall present the report to the President and to the Congress by December 31, 1980.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-205

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-206. The Commission shall terminate on February 15, 1981.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-206

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-3. Staff and Support

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-3

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-301. The Chairperson of the Commission shall appoint an Executive Director of the Commission.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-301

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-302. To the extent permitted by law, Executive Agencies shall provide funds, facilities, support, services and assistance for the Commission and its subgroups, and such information and advice as the Commission may request.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-302

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-303. Notwithstanding Executive Order 12024, the functions of the President under the Federal Advisory Committee Act (5 U.S.C. App. I), except that of reporting annually to Congress, shall be performed by the Director of the Office of Management and Budget with regard to the Commission and its subgroups. The Director is authorized to further delegate these responsibilities.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 248207; common-crawl capture 2024-04-15T13:16:30Z; Sec. 1-303
